package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"testing/fstest"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgconn"
)

type freshMigrationRow struct {
	tables int
	err    error
}

func (row freshMigrationRow) Scan(dest ...any) error {
	if row.err != nil {
		return row.err
	}
	if len(dest) != 1 {
		return errors.New("unexpected scan destination")
	}
	value, ok := dest[0].(*int)
	if !ok {
		return errors.New("unexpected scan type")
	}
	*value = row.tables
	return nil
}

var _ pgx.Row = freshMigrationRow{}

type freshMigrationRunnerFake struct {
	tables   int
	query    error
	failAt   string
	executed []string
}

func (runner *freshMigrationRunnerFake) QueryRow(context.Context, string, ...any) pgx.Row {
	return freshMigrationRow{tables: runner.tables, err: runner.query}
}

func (runner *freshMigrationRunnerFake) Exec(_ context.Context, sql string, _ ...any) (pgconn.CommandTag, error) {
	runner.executed = append(runner.executed, sql)
	if sql == runner.failAt {
		return pgconn.CommandTag{}, errors.New("sql failure")
	}
	return pgconn.CommandTag{}, nil
}

var _ freshMigrationRunner = (*freshMigrationRunnerFake)(nil)

func TestRunFreshMigrationsUsesOnlyForwardFilesInLexicalOrder(t *testing.T) {
	runner := &freshMigrationRunnerFake{}
	migrations := fstest.MapFS{
		"010_second.up.sql":   &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte("second")},
		"001_first.sql":       &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte("first")},
		"010_second.down.sql": &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte("rollback")},
		"notes.txt":           &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte("ignore")},
	}
	result, err := RunFreshMigrations(context.Background(), runner, migrations)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if result.Schema != FreshMigrationResultSchema || result.Status != "applied" || result.MigrationCount != 2 || result.Reason != "" || result.FailedMigration != "" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected result: %#v", result)
	}
	if len(runner.executed) != 2 || runner.executed[0] != "first" || runner.executed[1] != "second" {
		t.Fatalf("execution order = %#v", runner.executed)
	}
}

func TestRunFreshMigrationsRejectsNonEmptyTargetBeforeAnySQL(t *testing.T) {
	runner := &freshMigrationRunnerFake{tables: 1}
	result, err := RunFreshMigrations(context.Background(), runner, fstest.MapFS{"001_init.sql": &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte("first")}})
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrMigrationTargetNotEmpty) || result.Status != "failed" || result.Reason != "target_not_empty" || len(runner.executed) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("result=%#v err=%v executed=%#v", result, err, runner.executed)
	}
}

func TestRunFreshMigrationsStopsAtFirstFailedFile(t *testing.T) {
	runner := &freshMigrationRunnerFake{failAt: "second"}
	result, err := RunFreshMigrations(context.Background(), runner, fstest.MapFS{
		"001_first.sql":  &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte("first")},
		"002_second.sql": &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte("second")},
		"003_third.sql":  &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte("third")},
	})
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrMigrationFailed) || result.Status != "failed" || result.Reason != "migration_failed" || result.FailedMigration != "002_second.sql" || result.MigrationCount != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("result=%#v err=%v", result, err)
	}
	if len(runner.executed) != 2 || runner.executed[1] != "second" {
		t.Fatalf("execution did not stop at failed file: %#v", runner.executed)
	}
}

func TestOrderedForwardMigrationsRejectsEmptyDirectory(t *testing.T) {
	_, err := orderedForwardMigrations(fstest.MapFS{"001_init.down.sql": &fstest.MapFile{Data: []byte("rollback")}})
	if err == nil || err.Error() != "no forward migrations found" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
	}
}
